name: Mossy fieldstone, cedar shingle roof 006
glow_concept: glowing runes carved around the stone rim
prompt: a round fieldstone well with a peaked wooden roof on two posts, a windlass crank and a rope-hung bucket, mossy fieldstone, cedar shingle roof, about as tall as an adult person, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: glowing runes carved around the stone rim

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the bucket hanging over the shaft moves: it turns very slightly where it hangs, by a single pixel, and turns straight back. It is clearly visible in every single frame and never disappears. It is only MOVED, never redrawn: every line, edge and colour of it is copied from the first frame exactly, and it is displaced as one solid piece. Nothing in the picture lights up or begins to glow at any point: there is no light source here and none appears. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
